description: Lists Carryo teams accessible to the connected account, including team names, workspaceId values, roles, and available actions. Supports finding a team the user has chosen. Team creation, invitations, membership, and billing are managed in the Carryo web app.
name: team.list

workspaces.description: Carryo workspaces the authenticated user can access

capabilities.description: Workspace actions currently available to the authenticated user

canListLinks.description: Whether workspace links can be listed

canPublishLinks.description: Whether new workspace links can be published

canRevokeLinks.description: Whether workspace links can be revoked

canUpdateLinks.description: Whether workspace links can be updated

role.description: The authenticated user role in this workspace

workspaceId.description: Stable Carryo workspace identifier to use in later tool calls

title: Find Carryo Teams
